name: doc-linter
description: Lint agent-facing documents (SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, HANDOFF.md, README, runbooks, prompts) for ambiguity, terminology drift, passive voice, hedge words, stacked negations, and structure problems, using rules adapted from ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English — emitting a severity-ordered report with verbatim quotes and ready-to-paste rewrites. Harness-neutral; a pure-standard-library script decides the mechanical rules and prints the ones it leaves to the reader, so a missed line is reported as unchecked rather than as clean. Writes only to a document you point it at, in fix mode, after you accept the rewrites.
